Practised speed as distance ÷ time using 100 m ÷ 4 s = 25 m/s.
Distinguished scalar speed from velocity, including direction.
Discussed acceleration from changes in speed or direction.
Used a = (v − u)/t for braking and negative acceleration; the idea that braking is not acceleration remained at the last check.
Teach-back was not passed.
